description: Job ads on SEEK Australia or New Zealand for keywords and a place: title, company, location, salary text (when the advertiser shows one), work type, work arrangement, classification, teaser, listing date and job URL, plus the total match count, from SEEK's public job-search JSON service (the one its website uses). Up to 100 ads per page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

where.description: Suburb, city or state, e.g. Sydney, Melbourne VIC, Auckland (default: anywhere)
